messages:
incident-bot: [PAGER] HIGH_LATENCY alert for pool dedicated-eu-1 (pool-42). 95p/99p token latency >2s, queue depth spiking. Linked dashboard: https://grafana.company.internal/d/abcd1234. Paging olivia and oncall rota.

olivia (oncall): Ack, I'm on call. Looking at traces and queue metrics now.

sam (sre): Seeing sustained QPS spike from tenant=AcmePay hitting pooled endpoints (eu-west). Traffic ~3x baseline, many long tails. Some token-generation timeouts at the ingress queue.

olivia (oncall): Plan: apply quick mitigations to protect other tenants — 1) enforce tenant-level rate cap for heavy tenants, 2) temporarily lower autoscale_min for dedicated-eu-1 to give headroom, 3) toggle burst/burst_handoff off if needed, 4) disable prefix_caching write path to reduce KV pressure. Misha can you run the autoscale/burst toggles?

misha (eng-runtime): Running admin API now. Command: ```curl -X POST "https://control-plane.internal/api/v1/pools/dedicated-eu-1/config" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"autoscale_min":2, "burst_enabled":false}'``` Executing...

misha (eng-runtime): API response 200 OK. autoscale_min=2 applied, burst_enabled=false. Verifying runtime state.

incident-bot: Applied rate-limit rule: override(tenant=AcmePay) -> max_qps=50 (previously 200) via /rate/override. Rule id=rl-20260317-01.

lara (customer-success): Notified AcmePay about temporary throttle and asked them to pause high-volume batch jobs. They're acknowledging and will throttle back. I copied the pause instructions.

olivia (oncall): Metrics update: 95p latency dropping from ~2.4s -> ~0.9s over last 30s, queue depth falling. Great. Keeping mitigation in place while we stabilize (monitoring 15min).

sam (sre): Seeing a few 503s for low-QPS tenants during the strict cap — likely side-effect of queue reshuffle. If tail stays down we should ease burst flag back on but keep per-tenant quotas.

misha (eng-runtime): Re-enabled burst with conservative limits: ```curl -X POST "https://control-plane.internal/api/v1/pools/dedicated-eu-1/config" -d '{"burst_enabled":true, "burst_factor":2}'``` Response 200. Also set prefix_caching to read-only mode: ```PATCH /api/v1/features/prefix_caching -d '{"mode":"read-only"}'```

misha (eng-runtime): Runtime confirms: burst=true (factor=2), prefix_caching=read-only.

olivia (oncall): Latency stable at 95p~0.85s, error rate back to baseline. We will keep AcmePay quota at 75 r/s for the next 60 minutes as a compromise (rule rl-20260317-02). Lara, continue CS comms.

sam (sre): I'll draft an incident note with timeline, commands run, and metrics. Recommend follow-up: postmortem to discuss quota limits and backpressure behavior for dedicated pools, and a runbook update for burst toggles.

misha (eng-runtime): Taking overnight watch. If we see a repeat surge, escalate to eng-sre and prepare for a soft-deploy that limits long-run jobs via ingress heuristics.

olivia (oncall): Handoff: next oncall is @misha (eng-runtime). If anything degrades, page eng-sre immediately. Marking this incident as mitigated/resolved for now. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Incident mitigated at 4212345735 (mitigation: quota/reduced burst/autoscale_min change).
